svg.title: Haunts final icons, all appearances
svg.desc: The three final icon masters in iOS default, dark, tinted, Android adaptive, at 60 and 29 px.
svg.text: Final marks (D44): every appearance each store and OS asks for
Concept masters. iOS: default, dark, tinted (one silhouette). Android: adaptive (foreground inside the dashed 66/108 safe zone) and themed monochrome.
No ghost, eye, pin, radar, route, headstone, glass or bottle (D9, D11(d), MEM-1). The B bar is never animated. Dashed square = Android's 66 dp safe zone.
